description:
The process starts with identifying an idea for a new product or improvement to an existing one.
The R&D team conducts initial research and feasibility studies, followed by drafting design concepts.
After selecting a promising design, a prototype is built using available materials and resources.
The prototype undergoes various tests to assess its functionality, safety, and market potential.
Feedback from the testing phase is collected, and the prototype may be refined accordingly.
If a refinement is needed, then the testing phase is reinitiated.
The process ends when the prototype is either approved for further development or discarded.

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductDevelopment" name="Product Idea to Prototype Decision" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ProductIdea" name="Product idea or improvement need arises">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyIdea" name="Identify idea for new or improved product">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FeasibilityStudy" name="Conduct feasibility study">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>

    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFunctionality" name="Test prototype functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSafety" name="Test prototype safety">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestMarketPotential" name="Test prototype market potential">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect feedback from testing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementSplit" name="Refinement needed?" default="Flow_NoRefinement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RefineReturn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OutcomeSplit" name="Prototype outcome" default="Flow_Discarded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoRefinement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Discarded</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApprovePrototype" name="Approve prototype for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApproveEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DiscardPrototype" name="Discard prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Discarded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DiscardEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Approved" name="Case ended with approved outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApproveEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Discarded" name="Case ended with discarded outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DiscardEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_ProductIdea" targetRef="Task_IdentifyIdea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyIdea" targetRef="Task_ConductResearch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ConductResearch" targetRef="Task_FeasibilityStudy"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_FeasibilityStudy" targetRef="Task_DraftDesignConcepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_DraftDesignConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_TestMerge" targetRef="Task_TestFunctionality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_TestFunctionality" targetRef="Task_TestSafety"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_TestSafety" targetRef="Task_TestMarketPotential"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_TestMarketPotential" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementSplit" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefinement" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementSplit" targetRef="Gateway_OutcomeSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefineReturn" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Gateway_TestMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_OutcomeSplit" targetRef="Task_ApprovePrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Discarded" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_OutcomeSplit" targetRef="Task_DiscardPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveEnd" sourceRef="Task_ApprovePrototype" targetRef="End_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DiscardEnd" sourceRef="Task_DiscardPrototype" targetRef="End_Discarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
